vision_statement: A Unified Schema Validation Platform for High-Integrity Teams.

features.title: Strict Schema Enforcer
features.description: Middleware to block any request with non-concatenated keys.
features.rationale: Directly addresses the pain of 'Mismatched JSON keys'.

features.title: Auto-Concatenator
features.description: Utility to automatically strip underscores from legacy payloads.
features.rationale: Increases adoption by reducing friction for legacy teams.

features.title: Validation Dashboard
features.description: Visual report of schema compliance scores.
features.rationale: Provides visibility but not critical for day 1 function.
